meanings.en: in a way that is not fair or just
meanings.exampleEn: He was unjustly accused of stealing the money.
meanings.exampleTr: Parayı çalmakla haksız yere suçlandı.

meanings.en: not kind; cruel or harsh
meanings.exampleEn: It was unkind of her to laugh at his mistake.
meanings.exampleTr: Onun hatasına gülmesi kabacaydı.

meanings.en: without any limit or restriction
meanings.exampleEn: The plan offers unlimited internet access for a fixed price.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu paket sabit bir fiyata sınırsız internet erişimi sunuyor.

meanings.en: to remove a load from a vehicle or container
meanings.exampleEn: The workers began to unload the boxes from the truck.
meanings.exampleTr: İşçiler kutuları kamyondan boşaltmaya başladı.

meanings.en: to open something using a key or code
meanings.exampleEn: She used her phone to unlock the front door.
meanings.exampleTr: Ön kapının kilidini açmak için telefonunu kullandı.

meanings.tr: yanılma payı olmayan, açıkça belli, şüphe götürmez
meanings.en: so clear that it cannot be mistaken for anything else
meanings.exampleEn: There was an unmistakable smell of smoke in the air.
meanings.exampleTr: Havada açıkça belli olan bir duman kokusu vardı.

meanings.en: in a way that is clear and cannot be mistaken
meanings.exampleEn: Her voice was unmistakably angry on the phone.
meanings.exampleTr: Telefonda sesi açıkça öfkeliydi.

meanings.en: not normal or not found in nature
meanings.exampleEn: The light gave her skin an unnatural green color.
meanings.exampleTr: Işık, cildine doğal olmayan yeşil bir renk veriyordu.

meanings.en: not formally announced or approved by an authority
meanings.exampleEn: According to unofficial reports, more than fifty people were injured.
meanings.exampleTr: Resmi olmayan raporlara göre elliden fazla kişi yaralandı.

meanings.en: not liked by many people
meanings.exampleEn: The new tax proved very unpopular with voters.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeni vergi seçmenler arasında çok sevilmedi.

meanings.en: not based on what is real or practical
meanings.exampleEn: It is unrealistic to expect everyone to agree.
meanings.exampleTr: Herkesin hemfikir olmasını beklemek gerçekçi değil.

meanings.en: not fair or sensible
meanings.exampleEn: Asking us to work all weekend is completely unreasonable.
meanings.exampleTr: Bizden bütün hafta sonu çalışmamızı istemek tamamen mantıksız.

meanings.en: not able to be trusted or depended on
meanings.exampleEn: His old car is unreliable and breaks down often.
meanings.exampleTr: Onun eski arabası güvenilmez ve sık sık bozuluyor.

meanings.en: a state of dissatisfaction and disturbance among people
meanings.exampleEn: The rising prices caused widespread social unrest.
meanings.exampleTr: Yükselen fiyatlar yaygın bir toplumsal huzursuzluğa yol açtı.

meanings.en: dangerous or not safe
meanings.exampleEn: The old bridge was declared unsafe and closed to traffic.
meanings.exampleTr: Eski köprü güvensiz ilan edildi ve trafiğe kapatıldı.

meanings.en: not good enough to be acceptable
meanings.exampleEn: The quality of the work was unsatisfactory, so they asked for a refund.
meanings.exampleTr: İşin kalitesi tatmin edici değildi, bu yüzden para iadesi istediler.

meanings.en: willing to think of others rather than yourself
meanings.exampleEn: It was an unselfish act to give up his seat for the elderly woman.
meanings.exampleTr: Yaşlı kadına yerini vermesi özverili bir davranıştı.

meanings.en: impossible to stop or prevent
meanings.exampleEn: Once she started winning, she seemed unstoppable.
meanings.exampleTr: Kazanmaya başladığında durdurulamaz görünüyordu.

meanings.en: not achieving the intended result
meanings.exampleEn: Their first attempt to climb the mountain was unsuccessful.
meanings.exampleTr: Dağa tırmanma yönündeki ilk denemeleri başarısız oldu.

meanings.en: not appropriate or right for a purpose
meanings.exampleEn: These shoes are unsuitable for hiking in the mountains.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu ayakkabılar dağda yürüyüş yapmak için uygun değil.

meanings.en: not certain or confident about something
meanings.exampleEn: I am unsure whether this is the right decision.
meanings.exampleTr: Bunun doğru karar olup olmadığından emin değilim.

meanings.en: having little or no natural ability
meanings.exampleEn: He felt untalented compared to the other musicians in the band.
meanings.exampleTr: Gruptaki diğer müzisyenlere kıyasla kendini yeteneksiz hissediyordu.

meanings.en: to a degree that is impossible to imagine
meanings.exampleEn: The distances in space are unthinkably vast.
meanings.exampleTr: Uzaydaki mesafeler akıl almaz biçimde büyüktür.

meanings.en: to undo a knot or something that is tied
meanings.exampleEn: He bent down to untie his shoelaces.
meanings.exampleTr: Ayakkabı bağcıklarını çözmek için eğildi.

meanings.en: not given medical care or chemical treatment
meanings.exampleEn: If left untreated, the infection can become serious.
meanings.exampleTr: Tedavi edilmezse enfeksiyon ciddileşebilir.

meanings.en: not cut or made neat by trimming
meanings.exampleEn: The garden looked wild with its untrimmed hedges.
meanings.exampleTr: Bahçe, budanmamış çitleriyle vahşi görünüyordu.

meanings.en: the quality of being uncommon or strange
meanings.exampleEn: The unusualness of the design attracted a lot of attention.
meanings.exampleTr: Tasarımın sıra dışılığı çok dikkat çekti.

meanings.en: not wanting to do something
meanings.exampleEn: She was unwilling to lend him any more money.
meanings.exampleTr: Ona daha fazla borç para vermeye isteksizdi.

meanings.en: not sensible or showing poor judgement
meanings.exampleEn: It would be unwise to invest all your savings in one company.
meanings.exampleTr: Tüm birikiminizi tek bir şirkete yatırmak akılsızca olur.

meanings.en: not experienced in the practical ways of the world
meanings.exampleEn: His unworldly manner made it easy for others to deceive him.
meanings.exampleTr: Hayattan habersiz tavrı, başkalarının onu kandırmasını kolaylaştırıyordu.

meanings.en: the way a child is raised and educated by parents
meanings.exampleEn: She had a strict religious upbringing in a small village.
meanings.exampleTr: Küçük bir köyde katı dini bir terbiye ile yetiştirildi.

meanings.en: the most recent information or a new version of something
meanings.exampleEn: The app released an update to fix several bugs.
meanings.exampleTr: Uygulama, birkaç hatayı düzeltmek için bir güncelleme yayınladı.

meanings.en: an improvement to something or a better version
meanings.exampleEn: We paid extra for an upgrade to a first-class seat.
meanings.exampleTr: Birinci sınıf bir koltuğa yükseltme için fazladan ödeme yaptık.

meanings.en: standing or positioned vertically
meanings.exampleEn: Please return your seat to an upright position before landing.
meanings.exampleTr: Lütfen inişten önce koltuğunuzu dik konuma getirin.

meanings.en: with the top part at the bottom
meanings.exampleEn: The painting was hung upside down by mistake.
meanings.exampleTr: Tablo yanlışlıkla baş aşağı asılmıştı.

meanings.en: relating to a town or city
meanings.exampleEn: More people are moving from rural areas to urban centers.
meanings.exampleTr: Giderek daha fazla insan kırsal bölgelerden kentsel merkezlere taşınıyor.

meanings.en: in a way that needs immediate attention
meanings.exampleEn: The patient needs to be treated urgently.
meanings.exampleTr: Hastanın acilen tedavi edilmesi gerekiyor.

meanings.en: a person who uses a product, service or system
meanings.exampleEn: The website has over a million active users.
meanings.exampleTr: Web sitesinin bir milyondan fazla aktif kullanıcısı var.

meanings.en: to lead or guide someone to a place
meanings.exampleEn: The waiter ushered us to a table by the window.
meanings.exampleTr: Garson bizi pencere kenarındaki bir masaya götürdü.

meanings.tr: kamu hizmeti (elektrik, su vb.); fayda, yararlılık
meanings.en: a public service such as electricity or water; usefulness
meanings.exampleEn: The rent does not include utility bills like gas and water.
meanings.exampleTr: Kira, gaz ve su gibi kamu hizmeti faturalarını içermiyor.

meanings.en: to make practical use of something
meanings.exampleEn: The company aims to utilize solar energy in its factories.
meanings.exampleTr: Şirket, fabrikalarında güneş enerjisinden yararlanmayı hedefliyor.

meanings.en: to say something or make a sound with your voice
meanings.exampleEn: She was too shocked to utter a single word.
meanings.exampleTr: Tek bir kelime söyleyemeyecek kadar şaşkındı.

meanings.en: completely or absolutely
meanings.exampleEn: The room was utterly silent after she spoke.
meanings.exampleTr: O konuştuktan sonra oda tamamen sessizdi.

meanings.en: empty or not occupied
meanings.exampleEn: There are several vacant rooms in the hotel tonight.
meanings.exampleTr: Otelde bu gece birkaç boş oda var.

meanings.en: a substance that protects the body against a disease
meanings.exampleEn: Scientists developed a vaccine to fight the new virus.
meanings.exampleTr: Bilim insanları yeni virüsle savaşmak için bir aşı geliştirdi.

meanings.en: a card or person you choose on Valentine's Day
meanings.exampleEn: He sent his girlfriend a romantic valentine in February.
meanings.exampleTr: Şubatta sevgilisine romantik bir sevgili kartı gönderdi.

meanings.en: legally or officially acceptable; based on sound reasoning
meanings.exampleEn: Your ticket is valid for three months from the date of purchase.
meanings.exampleTr: Biletiniz satın alma tarihinden itibaren üç ay geçerlidir.

meanings.en: to disappear suddenly and completely
meanings.exampleEn: The magician made the coin vanish into thin air.
meanings.exampleTr: Sihirbaz parayı bir anda yok etti.

meanings.en: too much pride in your appearance or abilities
meanings.exampleEn: His vanity made it hard for him to accept any criticism.
meanings.exampleTr: Kendini beğenmişliği, herhangi bir eleştiriyi kabul etmesini zorlaştırıyordu.

meanings.en: a change or slight difference from the usual form
meanings.exampleEn: There is a lot of variation in the weather from day to day.
meanings.exampleTr: Havada günden güne büyük farklılıklar oluyor.

meanings.en: consisting of many different types or kinds
meanings.exampleEn: The museum offers a varied program of events for visitors.
meanings.exampleTr: Müze, ziyaretçiler için çeşitli bir etkinlik programı sunuyor.

meanings.en: the place where an event or activity happens
meanings.exampleEn: The stadium is a popular venue for concerts and sports.
meanings.exampleTr: Stadyum, konserler ve spor müsabakaları için popüler bir mekândır.

meanings.en: spoken rather than written; relating to words
meanings.exampleEn: They had a verbal agreement, but nothing was written down.
meanings.exampleTr: Sözlü bir anlaşmaları vardı ama hiçbir şey yazılı değildi.

meanings.en: using spoken words rather than writing
meanings.exampleEn: The instructions were given verbally during the meeting.
meanings.exampleTr: Talimatlar toplantı sırasında sözlü olarak verildi.

meanings.en: writing arranged in lines with rhythm, or a section of a poem or song
meanings.exampleEn: She read the first verse of the poem aloud.
meanings.exampleTr: Şiirin ilk kıtasını yüksek sesle okudu.

meanings.en: a particular form of something that differs from others
meanings.exampleEn: This is the latest version of the software.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu, yazılımın en son sürümüdür.

meanings.en: used to emphasize an exact or particular thing
meanings.exampleEn: This is the very book I was looking for.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu, tam da aradığım kitap.

meanings.tr: gazi, eski asker; deneyimli kişi, kıdemli
meanings.en: a former soldier or a person with long experience
meanings.exampleEn: He is a veteran of three different wars.
meanings.exampleTr: O, üç farklı savaşın gazisidir.

meanings.en: to move quickly back and forth with small movements
meanings.exampleEn: My phone began to vibrate silently in my pocket.
meanings.exampleTr: Telefonum cebimde sessizce titremeye başladı.

meanings.en: a continuous quick shaking movement
meanings.exampleEn: You could feel the vibration of the engine through the floor.
meanings.exampleTr: Motorun titreşimini zeminden hissedebiliyordunuz.

meanings.en: a person who watches television or something on a screen
meanings.exampleEn: The show attracted millions of viewers every week.
meanings.exampleTr: Program her hafta milyonlarca izleyici çekti.

meanings.en: physical or mental strength and energy
meanings.exampleEn: She tackled the new project with great vigor.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeni projeye büyük bir enerjiyle girişti.

meanings.en: strong, energetic and full of force
meanings.exampleEn: The doctor recommended thirty minutes of vigorous exercise daily.
meanings.exampleTr: Doktor günde otuz dakika güçlü egzersiz önerdi.

meanings.tr: güçlü bir şekilde, hararetle, enerjik biçimde
meanings.en: in a strong, energetic and forceful way
meanings.exampleEn: He shook his head vigorously to show he disagreed.
meanings.exampleTr: Aynı fikirde olmadığını göstermek için başını şiddetle salladı.

meanings.en: a large house, often in the countryside or near the sea
meanings.exampleEn: They rented a villa by the sea for the summer.
meanings.exampleTr: Yaz için deniz kenarında bir villa kiraladılar.

meanings.en: a person who lives in a village
meanings.exampleEn: The villagers gathered in the square to celebrate the festival.
meanings.exampleTr: Köylüler festivali kutlamak için meydanda toplandı.

meanings.en: a sour liquid used to flavor or preserve food
meanings.exampleEn: She added a little vinegar to the salad dressing.
meanings.exampleTr: Salata sosuna biraz sirke ekledi.

meanings.en: to break or fail to obey a law, rule or agreement
meanings.exampleEn: The company was fined for violating safety regulations.
meanings.exampleTr: Şirket, güvenlik düzenlemelerini ihlal ettiği için para cezasına çarptırıldı.

meanings.en: a computer-created environment that seems real
meanings.exampleEn: The game uses virtual reality to make players feel they are inside it.
meanings.exampleTr: Oyun, oyuncuların içindeymiş gibi hissetmesi için sanal gerçeklik kullanıyor.

meanings.en: almost completely; or by means of computer technology
meanings.exampleEn: The town was virtually empty during the holidays.
meanings.exampleTr: Kasaba tatil boyunca neredeyse bomboştu.
